_comment: Ward and notice pairs read by a person, one at a time. The pairs are the first 30 (or all, where a city has fewer) of the seeded sample printed by: node infra/aws-central/tools/india-ward-coverage.mjs --pairs <STATE/city> --seed 1. Titles are the notice pack's, with a long dash written as a hyphen. A change to a snapshot or to the notice packs changes the sample; the coverage tool refuses a file that no longer matches.
evidence: the title itself; the zone the snapshot records for a ward; every named OpenStreetMap feature inside the city's box (Geofabrik India extract, data of 6 Oct 2026)

verdicts.right: the pair is the ward the work is in
verdicts.wrong: it is not, for the reason given
verdicts.cannot tell: the evidence above does not settle it
verdicts.one of several: the title's name fits several wards at once and the work can be in only some of them
